name: Silver Pearl Hospitality & Lux
summary: Silver Pearl Hospitality & Luxury Spaces Ltd. is engaged in the ownership and management of various hospitality ventures, encompassing hotels, restaurants, and a café. Its collection of properties, which includes Osiya Shambhu Lodge, Osiya Shoshla Cafe, and Osiya Rangnoo Rakchham Retreat, is situated in Rakchham, Kinnaur, Himachal Pradesh. The enterprise was founded on January 31, 2011, and maintains its corporate headquarters in Tehsil Sangla, India.
